# `security-reports` — scan reports (autogenerated)

Outputs of **Trivy** (vulnerabilities, *misconfigurations*), **Bandit**
(Python static), **pip-audit** (dependencies) and **Gitleaks** (secrets)
generated by `security.yml` and by the image job in `ci.yml`.

`.gitignore` ignores everything in this directory except this README: reports
are published as **CI artifacts**, never as commits.

## Findings policy

| Severity | Action |
|---|---|
| Critical / High | Fixed or justified in writing before merge |
| Medium | Recorded and scheduled |
| Low / informational | Reviewed periodically |

The reports are **complementary, not definitive**: Trivy/Syft do not replace a
professional audit (see `SECURITY.md`).
